pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, complex, multi-lobed dark patches with high-frequency edge angularity and sharp pixel-level transitions. The spatial area of the patches significantly exceeds that of the separating light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow, light-colored pathways with frequent tri-point junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors remains largely uniform across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane creates a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck, presenting as a dense, short-haired geometric contour.

other_distinctive_markers: A second giraffe specimen is partially visible in the mid-ground background, positioned behind the primary subject's lower neck and chest area.
